notes: REF-BM-02: no real page-metadata fetch; title is locally derived from host+path, no description/favicon/preview at all. REF-BM-03: title is editable but there is no description field to edit and nothing is truly auto-collected. REF-BM-04: url/title/tags/notes editable but no description field exists. REF-BM-06: duplicate url only shows a non-blocking warning ('You can still save it') — still creates a second bookmark, does not converge to edit. REF-BM-07: list shows title/url/tags/notes but no description or favicon. REF-BM-10: tags input is a plain comma-separated text field, no autocomplete. REF-BM-12: keyword search covers title/url/tags only, not notes, and there is no description field. REF-BM-14/15/16: search is plain case-insensitive substring matching only — no #tag syntax, no AND/OR/NOT/parentheses, no quoted-phrase exact match. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read-later flag or view exists. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions in the UI. REF-BM-22: list is fixed most-recent-first with no user-selectable sort key. REF-BM-23: notes are rendered as plain text, not parsed/rendered as markdown. REF-BM-24/25: no snapshot (HTML/PDF/Internet Archive) capability. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archive flag, list, or archive-vs-delete distinction. REF-BM-29: no bundle/saved-filter feature. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. REF-BM-32: no user settings (sort/displayed items/font size).
